title: PXAPI business context v1
description: Output of the Business Context Analyzer model job (Confluence 39846055 §6): what kind of business the analysed website belongs to, stated as typed facts that are evidenced publicly. A research failure is explicit, never inferred from missing facts: a NOT_ASSESSED context carries a reason and no facts, and a COMPLETED context with an empty fact list means nothing could be publicly evidenced — neither is a statement about the quality of the business. Every VERIFIED_FACT and every SUPPORTED_INFERENCE cites at least one source; only a HYPOTHESIS may stand without one.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this business context belongs to.

generated_at.description: Required. When the business context was generated, or when the research was attempted for a NOT_ASSESSED context.

producer_ref.description: Required. What produced the business context; the model behind it is interchangeable.

research_state.description: Required. Whether the business research ran to completion. COMPLETED: the facts are the result, an empty list included. NOT_ASSESSED: the research did not happen; the context explains why and carries no facts.

not_assessed_reason.description: Conditional. Present if and only if research_state is NOT_ASSESSED: why the business research did not happen. Every reason describes the analysis process, never the business.

facts.description: Required. The publicly evidenced facts about the business; intent sets and diagnosis claims reference them by fact_id. An empty array in a COMPLETED context means nothing could be publicly evidenced; in a NOT_ASSESSED context the array is always empty because no research happened, and carries no meaning of its own.

fact_id.description: Required. The stable identity of this fact; intent sets and diagnosis claims reference it.

category.description: Required. Which aspect of the business the fact describes (Confluence 39846055 §6).

statement.description: Required. The fact itself, stated in evidence language as a single assertion.

evidence_class.description: Required. The authority of the statement. A VERIFIED_FACT or SUPPORTED_INFERENCE is backed by at least one source; a HYPOTHESIS may have none.

source_refs.description: Required. Where the fact was evidenced. At least one source for a VERIFIED_FACT or SUPPORTED_INFERENCE. An empty array means the statement rests on no public source, which is only legal for a HYPOTHESIS.

confidence.description: Required. Confidence in the fact on the 0..5 scale.
